media.title: Ted Lasso
media.overview: Ted Lasso centers on an idealistic — and clueless — all-American football coach hired to manage an English football club — despite having no soccer coaching experience at all.

media.title: Chad Powers
media.overview: Eight years after an unforgivable mistake nukes his promising college football career, hotshot quarterback Russ Holliday tries to resurrect his dreams by disguising himself as Chad Powers — a talented oddball who walks onto the struggling South Georgia Catfish.

media.title: Dark Matter
media.overview: Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels of the decade, Dark Matter is a story about the road not taken. The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.

media.title: The Last of Us
media.overview: After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.

media.title: Paradise
media.overview: Paradise is set in a serene community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals. But this tranquillity explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high-stakes investigation unfolds.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: American football coach Ted Lasso is hired by a wealthy divorcée to coach the English soccer team AFC Richmond.

episodes.title: The Hope That Kills You
episodes.overview: Richmond plays a climactic match that will determine the fates of Ted and his club.

episodes.title: Biscuits
episodes.overview: It's Ted's first day of coaching, and fans aren't happy. He makes little headway but remains undeterred as the team plays its first match.

episodes.title: Trent Crimm: The Independent
episodes.overview: To arrange an in-depth exposé, Rebecca pairs cynical journalist Trent Crimm with Ted for a day. Ted and Roy venture into the community.

episodes.title: For the Children
episodes.overview: Rebecca hosts the team's annual charity benefit, where Ted stages a reconciliation between Roy and Jamie.

episodes.title: Tan Lines
episodes.overview: With his wife and son visiting from America, Ted makes drastic changes to the lineup during a critical match.

episodes.title: Two Aces
episodes.overview: When Jamie refuses to train, Ted turns to talented new signing Dani Rojas and the team is struck by an age-old curse.

episodes.title: Make Rebecca Great Again
episodes.overview: Rebecca celebrates her first anniversary as a divorcée as the team plays a match in Liverpool.

episodes.title: The Diamond Dogs
episodes.overview: Ted and Roy are both having relationship problems. Ted consults the Diamond Dogs while Roy lays it on the line with Keeley.

episodes.title: All Apologies
episodes.overview: After a series of mistakes on the pitch, pressure mounts to bench Roy. Rebecca finally reveals the truth to Ted.

episodes.title: Goodbye Earl
episodes.overview: AFC Richmond brings in a sports psychologist to help the team overcome their unprecedented seven game tie-streak.

episodes.title: No Weddings and a Funeral
episodes.overview: Rebecca is stunned by a sudden loss. The team rallies to show their support, but Ted finds himself grappling with a piece of his past.

episodes.title: Midnight Train to Royston
episodes.overview: A billionaire football enthusiast from Ghana makes Sam an unbelievable offer. Ted plans something special for Dr. Sharon's last day with the team.

episodes.title: Inverting the Pyramid of Success
episodes.overview: Richmond gets their final chance to win promotion as Ted deals with the fallout of Trent Crimm's painfully honest exposé.

episodes.title: Lavender
episodes.overview: Ted is surprised by the reappearance of a familiar face. Roy tries out a new gig.

episodes.title: Do the Right-est Thing
episodes.overview: Rebecca has a special visitor shadow her at work. A player's return is not welcomed by the team.

episodes.title: Carol of the Bells
episodes.overview: It's Christmas in Richmond. Rebecca enlists Ted for a secret mission, Roy and Keeley search for a miracle, and the Higginses open up their home.

episodes.title: Rainbow
episodes.overview: Nate learns how to be assertive from Keeley and Rebecca. Ted asks Roy for a favor.

episodes.title: The Signal
episodes.overview: Ted is fired up that the new team dynamic seems to be working. But will they have a chance in the semifinal?

episodes.title: Headspace
episodes.overview: With things turning around for Richmond, it's time for everyone to work on their issues—like Ted's discomfort, Nate's confidence, and Roy's attention.

episodes.title: Man City
episodes.overview: Ted and Dr. Sharon realize they might have to meet each other halfway. Tensions are high as the team prepares for the semifinal.

episodes.title: Beard After Hours
episodes.overview: After the semifinal, Beard sets out on an all-night odyssey through London in an effort to collect his thoughts.

episodes.title: Smells Like Mean Spirit
episodes.overview: The newly promoted AFC Richmond face mockery as pundits predict they'll finish dead last this season.

episodes.title: International Break
episodes.overview: While some of the Greyhounds head home to play for their countries in international matches, Edwin Akufo brings a business proposal to Rebecca.

episodes.title: Mom City
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest has Ted on edge. When Richmond travel to Manchester for a big match, Roy and Keeley become concerned about Jamie.

episodes.title: So Long, Farewell
episodes.overview: Season finale. AFC Richmond play their final match of the season.

episodes.title: (I Don't Want to Go to) Chelsea
episodes.overview: News of a top player looking to move to London sends the English clubs into a frenzy. Richmond play their first game back in the Premier League.
Richmond adjust to an exciting change, but Jamie has reservations. Ted learns there's something new going on back in Kansas as well.

episodes.title: Big Week
episodes.overview: Everyone's feeling the pressure as Richmond gear up to play West Ham. Ted is reunited with an old friend.

episodes.title: Signs
episodes.overview: With their season in a tailspin, Richmond try to right the ship against mighty Manchester City. Off the pitch, everyone faces their own setbacks.

episodes.title: Sunflowers
episodes.overview: A friendly match takes the team to Amsterdam, where one night out unlocks truths for many.

episodes.title: The Strings That Bind Us
episodes.overview: The Greyhounds try a new strategy that has everyone thinking outside the box. Sam prepares to host a VIP guest at Ola's.

episodes.title: We'll Never Have Paris
episodes.overview: While watching Henry, Ted fights the urge to spiral when Michelle and Dr. Jacob go on a romantic trip. An online leak has massive implications for Keeley.

episodes.title: La Locker Room Aux Folles
episodes.overview: Colin and Isaac's friendship is tested. Roy is asked to do a press conference.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.overview: A few years after Ted leaves Richmond, some familiar faces visit him in Kansas…or is it Missouri?

episodes.title: Curiouser and Curiouser!
episodes.overview: Ted returns to Richmond to meet the Lady Greyhounds, but not everyone is glad to see him.

episodes.title: Richmond's Got Talent
episodes.overview: Richmond's shareholders are unsure about a women's team. The coaches hold tryouts to fill out their roster.

episodes.title: Greyhounds' Day Off
episodes.overview: The coaches must figure out how to break up team cliques. Ted adjusts to life outside the locker room.

episodes.title: Riches of Embarrassment
episodes.overview: The ladies face off against Chelsea. Alice feels the pressure. Rebecca navigates a complicated dynamic.

episodes.title: Don't Jump Around Much Anymore
episodes.overview: It's New Year's Eve! The team celebrates big. Rebecca, Roy, and Keeley ring it in with an old friend.

episodes.title: Yes & Baby
episodes.overview: Alice and Ted try stepping outside their comfort zones. Zelda helps with a new problem at Richmond.

episodes.title: 1st Quarter
episodes.overview: Years after bad boy QB Russ Holliday nuked his college football career, he attempts to walk on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish program disguised as a young man named Chad Powers.

episodes.title: 2nd Quarter
episodes.overview: Chad struggles to compete for the starting QB job then struggles even more maintaining his new identity at Coach Hudson's lake house barbecue.

episodes.title: 3rd Quarter
episodes.overview: It's the second half of the season opener against Ole Miss and the Catfish are losing. Stuck on the sidelines together, Chad and Ricky team up and try to save the day.

episodes.title: 4th Quarter
episodes.overview: The night before an away game in Knoxville, Russ and Danny must sneak out of the team hotel and go on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

episodes.title: 5th Quarter
episodes.overview: The Catfish are 5-0. Chad Powers is a superstar, and ESPN wants to feature him on College Gameday. What could go wrong?

episodes.title: 6th Quarter
episodes.overview: On the eve of the biggest game of the season, the truth about Chad Powers threatens to emerge.

episodes.title: 7th Quarter
episodes.overview: Russ and Danny's tenuous new alliance with Ricky is tested when Chad suffers a mid-game injury.

episodes.title: 8th Quarter
episodes.overview: Ahead of the team's big bye week house party, Coach Hudson grows increasingly suspicious of Chad's behavior.

episodes.title: 9th Quarter
episodes.overview: With the Catfish stranded in the airport after a tough away game, Tricia cozies up to Chad – and starts asking dangerous questions.

episodes.title: 10th Quarter
episodes.overview: To legitimize his backstory, Russ brings his real father to the Catfish homecoming banquet as Chad's dad – Howard Powers.

episodes.title: 11th Quarter
episodes.overview: Gerry pursues the truth about Chad Powers, while Russ, Ricky, and Danny do everything they can to stop him.

episodes.title: 12th Quarter
episodes.overview: Chad and the Catfish must beat Texas to make the Playoff, but Gerry has other plans.

episodes.title: Are You Happy in Your Life?
episodes.overview: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

episodes.title: Trip of a Lifetime
episodes.overview: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense - he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.overview: Leighton and Amanda show Jason his groundbreaking invention. Daniela and Jason2 throw a dinner party.

episodes.title: The Corridor
episodes.overview: Jason and Amanda fight to stay alive in the dangerous Corridor. Jason2 makes some life changes and visits an old friend.

episodes.title: Worldless
episodes.overview: As they learn more about the Box, Jason and Amanda see alternate versions of their lives. Jason2 begins training a potential investor.

episodes.title: Superposition
episodes.overview: Daniela suspects something's not right with her husband. Jason and Amanda grow closer.

episodes.title: In the Fires of Dead Stars
episodes.overview: Jason and Amanda visit a breathtaking world. To hide the truth from Daniela, Jason2 takes desperate action.

episodes.title: Jupiter
episodes.overview: Panicked and cornered, Jason2 tells Daniela and Charlie they need to leave town immediately.

episodes.title: Entanglement
episodes.overview: Season finale. The Dessens' world comes crashing down.

episodes.title: A Quiet Life
episodes.overview: The Dessens receive an unwelcome visitor. Ryan finds Amanda. Leighton finds himself.

episodes.title: A Perfect World
episodes.overview: The search for a new home starts again. Amanda and Ryan set off on a quest.

episodes.title: Everything Beautiful, Everything Terrible
episodes.overview: Jason's fixation on the Box tests his marriage. Ryan and Amanda step into a world forever changed.

episodes.title: What the Universe Is Made Of
When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.overview: Twenty years after a fungal outbreak ravages the planet, survivors Joel and Tess are tasked with a mission that could change everything.

episodes.title: Infected
episodes.overview: After escaping the QZ, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate while navigating the ruins of a long-abandoned Boston.

episodes.title: Long, Long Time
episodes.overview: When a stranger approaches his compound, survivalist Bill forges an unlikely connection. Later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance.

episodes.title: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.overview: After abandoning their truck in Kansas City, Joel and Ellie attempt to escape without drawing the attention of a vindictive rebel leader.

episodes.title: Endure and Survive
episodes.overview: While attempting to evade the rebels, Joel and Ellie cross paths with the most wanted man in Kansas City. Kathleen continues her hunt.

episodes.title: Kin
episodes.overview: After ignoring the advice of locals, Joel and Ellie descend deeper into dangerous territory in search of the Fireflies – and Tommy.

episodes.title: Left Behind
episodes.overview: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie looks back on the night that changed everything.

episodes.title: When We Are in Need
episodes.overview: Ellie crosses paths with a vengeful group of survivors – and draws the attention of its leader. A weakened Joel faces a new threat.

episodes.title: Look for the Light
episodes.overview: A pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Later, Joel and Ellie near the end of their journey.

episodes.title: Future Days
episodes.overview: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

episodes.title: Through the Valley
episodes.overview: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

episodes.title: The Path
episodes.overview: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

episodes.title: Day One
episodes.overview: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

episodes.title: Feel Her Love
episodes.overview: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

episodes.title: The Price
episodes.overview: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. As their rift continues to widen, Ellie prepares for a confrontation, while Joel makes a difficult choice out on patrol.

episodes.title: Convergence
episodes.overview: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

episodes.title: Wildcat is Down
episodes.overview: It's just another day in Paradise until Xavier Collins discovers one of the world's most powerful individuals has been viciously murdered. Xavier analyzes the crime scene while recalling his complex relationship with the victim.

episodes.title: Sinatra
episodes.overview: Agent Xavier Collins is interrogated. Samantha Redmond (codenamed Sinatra) begins to reassure the community as she reflects on how she got to Paradise.

episodes.title: The Architect of Social Well-Being
episodes.overview: Isolated, Xavier seeks answers on his own and cautiously turns to Dr. Gabriela Torabi. Meanwhile, Billy and Jane feel the pressure from Robinson's investigation.

episodes.title: Agent Billy Pace
episodes.overview: The citizens of Paradise celebrate at the annual carnival. Xavier and Billy delve deeper into their investigation.

episodes.title: In the Palaces of Crowned Kings
episodes.overview: Xavier faces the consequences of his investigation, forcing him to consider how to proceed. Meanwhile Cal's family history and his last days are examined.

episodes.title: You Asked for Miracles
episodes.overview: Xavier and Robinson set their plans in motion while Sinatra works to preserve the status quo in Paradise.

episodes.title: The Day
episodes.overview: Sinatra and Xavier confront the past, returning to the harrowing day that brought them to Paradise.

episodes.title: The Man Who Kept the Secrets
episodes.overview: Xavier and Robinson race to find President Bradford's murderer before it's too late.

episodes.title: Graceland
episodes.overview: Annie is a tour guide in Memphis, TN when the world ends. Her survival in the ensuing years after The Day is revealed as well as her encounter with a traveling group of survivors.

episodes.title: Mayday
episodes.overview: Xavier battles the elements and other threats as he follows a broadcast to Atlanta in search of his wife, Teri.

episodes.title: Another Day in Paradise
episodes.overview: Sinatra wakes to discover a new paradigm in the bunker and takes steps to safeguard its biggest secret.

episodes.title: A Holy Charge
episodes.overview: Xavier and Annie travel to Atlanta, contrasting life in this new world and the one he left behind in the bunker.

episodes.title: The Mailman
episodes.overview: Xavier meets Gary and learns what happened to Teri on The Day.

episodes.title: Jane
episodes.overview: Xavier and Gary set their plan in motion. Back in Paradise, Sinatra takes action, while Gabriela follows a new lead, and Jane's past is revealed.

episodes.title: The Final Countdown
episodes.overview: Xavier has unfinished business. Meanwhile, Sinatra meets with Link as Paradise prepares for a potential threat.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.overview: Worlds collide. Time is of the essence for Xavier. Link and his team spring into action. Sinatra puts it all on the line.
